psalm-37-1.verse: Do not fret because of evildoers, Be not envious toward wrongdoers.
psalm-37-1.prayer: Lord, help me not become discouraged when I see wrongdoing prosper. Keep my eyes focused on You and Your faithfulness.

psalm-37-2.verse: For they will wither quickly like the grass And fade like the green herb.
psalm-37-2.prayer: Father, remind me that earthly success is temporary, but Your kingdom and Your promises endure forever.

psalm-37-3.verse: Trust in the Lord and do good; Dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
psalm-37-3.prayer: Lord, help me trust in You and continue doing good. Teach me to live faithfully wherever You have placed me.

psalm-37-4.verse: Delight yourself in the Lord; And He will give you the desires of your heart.
psalm-37-4.prayer: Father, help me delight myself in You above all else. Shape my desires so they align with Your will.

psalm-37-5.verse: Commit your way to the Lord, Trust also in Him, and He will do it.
psalm-37-5.prayer: Lord, I commit my life and my plans to You. Guide my steps and help me trust Your direction.

psalm-37-6.verse: He will bring forth your righteousness as the light And your judgment as the noonday.
psalm-37-6.prayer: Father, thank You that You bring righteousness and truth into the light. Help me trust Your timing.

psalm-37-7.verse: Rest in the Lord and wait patiently for Him; Do not fret because of him who prospers in his way, Because of the man who carries out wicked schemes.
psalm-37-7.prayer: Lord, teach me to rest in You and wait patiently for Your work to unfold in my life.

psalm-37-8.verse: Cease from anger and forsake wrath; Do not fret; it leads only to evildoing.
psalm-37-8.prayer: Father, remove anger, bitterness, and frustration from my heart. Fill me instead with peace and trust.

psalm-37-9.verse: For evildoers will be cut off, But those who wait for the Lord, they will inherit the land.
psalm-37-9.prayer: Lord, help me remember that those who hope in You will inherit blessings far greater than anything this world offers.

psalm-37-10.verse: Yet a little while and the wicked man will be no more; And you will look carefully for his place and he will not be there.
psalm-37-10.prayer: Father, remind me that evil is temporary, but Your reign is eternal.

psalm-37-11.verse: But the humble will inherit the land And will delight themselves in abundant prosperity.
psalm-37-11.prayer: Lord, cultivate humility within me and help me experience the peace that comes from trusting You.

psalm-37-12.verse: The wicked plots against the righteous And gnashes at him with his teeth.
psalm-37-12.prayer: Father, when others oppose what is right, help me remain faithful and confident in Your protection.

psalm-37-13.verse: The Lord laughs at him, For He sees his day is coming.
psalm-37-13.prayer: Lord, thank You that You see the end from the beginning and that nothing takes You by surprise.

psalm-37-14.verse: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent their bow To cast down the afflicted and the needy, To slay those who are upright in conduct.
psalm-37-14.prayer: Father, protect the vulnerable and help me stand for what is right with courage and compassion.

psalm-37-15.verse: Their sword will enter their own heart, And their bows will be broken.
psalm-37-15.prayer: Lord, I trust that Your justice will prevail. Help me leave judgment in Your hands.

psalm-37-16.verse: Better is the little of the righteous Than the abundance of many wicked.
psalm-37-16.prayer: Father, teach me to value a life of righteousness over worldly wealth and success.

psalm-37-17.verse: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, But the Lord sustains the righteous.
psalm-37-17.prayer: Lord, thank You for sustaining those who trust in You. Strengthen me through every season.

psalm-37-18.verse: The Lord knows the days of the blameless, And their inheritance will be forever.
psalm-37-18.prayer: Father, thank You that You know every detail of my life and faithfully care for me.

psalm-37-19.verse: They will not be ashamed in the time of evil, And in the days of famine they will have abundance.
psalm-37-19.prayer: Lord, help me trust You during difficult times and remember that You are my provider.

psalm-37-20.verse: But the wicked will perish; And the enemies of the Lord will be like the glory of the pastures, They vanish—like smoke they vanish away.
psalm-37-20.prayer: Father, remind me that only what is built upon You will last forever.

psalm-37-21.verse: The wicked borrows and does not pay back, But the righteous is gracious and gives.
psalm-37-21.prayer: Lord, help me live generously and reflect Your kindness toward others.

psalm-37-22.verse: For those blessed by Him will inherit the land, But those cursed by Him will be cut off.
psalm-37-22.prayer: Father, thank You for Your blessing upon those who follow You. Help me walk faithfully in Your ways.

psalm-37-23.verse: The steps of a man are established by the Lord, And He delights in his way.
psalm-37-23.prayer: Lord, establish my steps and guide me according to Your purpose and wisdom.

psalm-37-24.verse: When he falls, he will not be hurled headlong, Because the Lord is the One who holds his hand.
psalm-37-24.prayer: Father, when I stumble, thank You for lifting me up and helping me continue forward.

psalm-37-25.verse: I have been young and now I am old, Yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken Or his descendants begging bread.
psalm-37-25.prayer: Lord, thank You for Your lifelong faithfulness and provision. Help me remember Your goodness.

psalm-37-26.verse: All day long he is gracious and lends, And his descendants are a blessing.
psalm-37-26.prayer: Father, let generosity and compassion characterize my life as they reflect Your heart.

psalm-37-27.verse: Depart from evil and do good, So you will abide forever.
psalm-37-27.prayer: Lord, help me turn away from evil and pursue what is good and pleasing in Your sight.

psalm-37-28.verse: For the Lord loves justice And does not forsake His godly ones; They are preserved forever, But the descendants of the wicked will be cut off.
psalm-37-28.prayer: Father, thank You for loving justice and never abandoning those who trust in You.

psalm-37-29.verse: The righteous will inherit the land And dwell in it forever.
psalm-37-29.prayer: Lord, help me focus on the eternal inheritance You have prepared for Your people.

psalm-37-30.verse: The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, And his tongue speaks justice.
psalm-37-30.prayer: Father, let wisdom guide my words and help me speak truth with grace and love.

psalm-37-31.verse: The law of his God is in his heart; His steps do not slip.
psalm-37-31.prayer: Lord, write Your Word upon my heart so that I may walk faithfully in Your ways.

psalm-37-32.verse: The wicked spies upon the righteous And seeks to kill him.
psalm-37-32.prayer: Father, protect me from those things that seek to pull me away from You and weaken my faith.

psalm-37-33.verse: The Lord will not leave him in his hand Or let him be condemned when he is judged.
psalm-37-33.prayer: Lord, thank You that You never abandon Your people and that Your hand remains upon us.

psalm-37-34.verse: Wait for the Lord and keep His way, And He will exalt you to inherit the land; When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
psalm-37-34.prayer: Father, help me wait patiently for You and trust Your perfect timing in all things.

psalm-37-35.verse: I have seen a wicked, violent man Spreading himself like a luxuriant tree in its native soil.
psalm-37-35.prayer: Lord, remind me that worldly power is temporary and cannot compare to Your eternal kingdom.

psalm-37-36.verse: Then he passed away, and lo, he was no more; I sought for him, but he could not be found.
psalm-37-36.prayer: Father, help me keep an eternal perspective and remember what truly matters.

psalm-37-37.verse: Mark the blameless man, and behold the upright; For the man of peace will have a posterity.
psalm-37-37.prayer: Lord, help me pursue integrity, peace, and faithfulness throughout my life.

psalm-37-38.verse: But transgressors will be altogether destroyed; The posterity of the wicked will be cut off.
psalm-37-38.prayer: Father, strengthen my resolve to walk in obedience and remain faithful to You.

psalm-37-39.verse: But the salvation of the righteous is from the Lord; He is their strength in time of trouble.
psalm-37-39.prayer: Lord, thank You for being my salvation, my refuge, and my strength in times of trouble.

psalm-37-40.verse: The Lord helps them and delivers them; He delivers them from the wicked and saves them, Because they take refuge in Him.
psalm-37-40.prayer: Father, thank You for helping and delivering those who trust in You. May my confidence always remain in Your faithfulness.

psalm-37-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for Your faithfulness, justice, and provision. Help me trust You when I am tempted to compare my life to others or become discouraged by what I see around me. Teach me to delight in You, commit my ways to You, and wait patiently for Your perfect timing. Establish my steps, strengthen my faith, and help me live with integrity, generosity, and peace. May my life remain firmly rooted in Your promises and Your unfailing love.

In Jesus’ name, Amen. 🙏🏻
